integrity: The proof counts the published Zeckendorf regular language exactly and combines it with the published bounded zero-run theorem. A standalone verifier independently checks the regular-expression count, direct cube endings on a finite prefix, Fibonacci cutoffs, and the proved sandwich. Infinite claims follow from the symbolic proof, not the finite checks.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the exact run-start count and the sharp order \(Z(N)=\Theta((\log N)^3)\), but not an exact formula or leading constant for \(Z(N)\). It is specific to the Fibonacci word.
title: Cubic logarithmic deficit for cube endings in the Fibonacci word
